knowledge_roles.description: what kind of knowledge this contributes

evidence_roles.description: what this item is allowed to establish HERE

retrieved_at.description: docs/27: RFC 3339 time THIS item was fetched, written at harvest time. Optional in standalone runs; REQUIRED for a governed receipt (never back-filled with 'now').

published_at_if_known.description: docs/27: the publish date the page shows (RFC 3339), or null when it shows none. A known date is never omitted to read as fresh.

hypothesis_ids.description: docs/27: GOVERNED mode only — the adapter's hyp_… ids this item bears on (a subset of the HarnessActionV1's).

metric.description: docs/27: a number the source states (price, rating, count): {name, value, unit, sample_n?}. Carried into a governed receipt as metric_if_present.
